column10:
JodaCare is a Norwegian platform for coordination around a care recipient with complex needs, connecting the people and services that usually work in separate silos: family at home, school or day services, respite housing and municipal health personnel. I would like to explore:

How plans and daily observations in Pasientens planer can be shared across these silos, including with staff outside the health service (school, respite) and with next of kin.
How access for relatives and care teams can be expressed in FHIR (CareTeam, RelatedPerson, Consent), and who decides who sees what.
How the individual plan (individuell plan) and the municipal coordinator role can be represented in FHIR.
How a non-EPJ municipal welfare application can read from and write to Pasientens planer, and what is required for login and authorization (ID-porten, HelseID, SMART on FHIR).

I come from the product side and would value working with developers in the track on a concrete scenario, for example passing information from an evening in respite housing to the school the next morning.
